summary: GFL Environmental filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated Oct 1, 2026, announcing the appointment of Allen Gransch as Chief Operating Officer effective immediately. Gransch joined GFL as EVP on Sept 1, 2026 via the SECURE Waste Infrastructure acquisition and previously served as SECURE's CFO, COO and CEO. Outgoing COO Billy Soffera transitions to senior strategic advisor. No financial terms, board recommendation or advisor were disclosed. The event is an abrupt senior operating leadership change, not a transaction; watch for integration execution risk around the SECURE assets and any follow-on executive turnover.
